scripts.python:format:check: uv run black --check apps/cli/agentguard_cli apps/guard-api/guard_api packages/agentguard-core/agentguard_core packages/agentguard-langgraph-adapter/agentguard_langgraph_adapter
scripts.python:check: uv run ruff check apps/cli apps/guard-api packages/agentguard-core packages/agentguard-langgraph-adapter && pnpm python:format:check && pnpm python:typecheck
scripts.guard-api:dev: sh -c 'test -f .env || { echo "缺少根目录 .env，请先复制 .env.example" >&2; exit 1; }; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; exec uv run uvicorn guard_api.main:app --host "${AGENTGUARD_HOST:-127.0.0.1}" --port "${AGENTGUARD_PORT:-8088}"'
scripts.guard-api:launch: sh -c 'test -f .env || { echo "缺少根目录 .env，请先复制 .env.example" >&2; exit 1; }; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; test -n "${AGENTGUARD_CONTROL_TOKEN:-}" || { echo ".env 中缺少 AGENTGUARD_CONTROL_TOKEN" >&2; exit 1; }; response=$(curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${AGENTGUARD_CONTROL_TOKEN}" "http://${AGENTGUARD_HOST:-127.0.0.1}:${AGENTGUARD_PORT:-8088}/v1/auth/browser/launch") || exit $?; launch_code=$(printf "%s" "$response" | sed -n "s/.*\"launch_code\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p"); test -n "$launch_code" || { echo "Guard API 响应中缺少 launch_code" >&2; exit 1; }; printf "http://localhost:5173/?launch_code=%s\n" "$launch_code"'
scripts.openclaw:bench-shim:test: node --test scripts/openclaw-bench-shim.test.mjs scripts/openclaw-bench-tools-dev.test.mjs scripts/openclaw-command-resolve.test.mjs scripts/openclaw-plugin-dev.test.mjs scripts/openclaw-runtime-smoke.test.mjs
